description: A Method to Group Wastewater Collection Systems by Key Attributes to Evaluate Potential Impacts from Urban Water Conservation is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Porse, Erik (deposited on HydroShare). In California, over 400 water supply agencies provide water to 36 million people living in cities and suburbs. The wastewater generated by homes, businesses, and industrial facilities is managed by hundreds of wastewater collection, treatment, reuse, and recovery systems. Coverage: California, United States. The resource was created 2022-12-19 and last updated 2023-01-28; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
